packageRules.description: The k8s.io modules track the cluster's Kubernetes version, which is v1.36. v0.37 exists and the cluster does not, so take patches within the current minor. Moving the minor is a deliberate change: the modules and their transitive pins move together, and a partial move does not compile.
The structured-merge-diff major is chosen by k8s.io/apimachinery, not by us. v7 does not compile against apimachinery v0.36; that failure is what this prevents.
